publications.name: Example publication with an explicit feed_url

_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — never commit real subscriptions. Copy to acquisition/substack/subscriptions.json (gitignored) or supply an operator path. Each entry needs a 'name' plus either 'feed_url' or 'base_url' (which gets '/feed' appended). 'source_tier' is optional (defaults to DEFAULT_SUBSTACK_SOURCE_TIER=4). Mirrors acquisition/opt_in/example_manifest.json.
